subject: 28-year-old man with wave-like curls
art_direction: 28岁男性浓卷发画成大墨浪，紫色立领与橙色背景，粗线留白而有神。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Paint an original 28-year-old man whose dense curly hair is simplified into three large ink-wave shapes. He has a long face, broad cheekbones, and an open, slightly mischievous smile. Dress him in a fully closed violet stand-collar jacket with one diagonal fastening. Use thick black brush contours, reserved paper highlights, and a flat burnt-orange background. Tilt his head a little while keeping the shoulders level. Let the hair and collar carry the design; avoid tiny hatching, floating symbols, elaborate jewelry, and resemblance to a famous performer. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
